user_reported_bug: Remove the Stripe integration and make it ready for deployment
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused API/UI/deployment checks confirm the main Stripe Connect router/endpoints are gone, store-boost checkout is disabled with 503, core endpoints boot, wallet checkout works, and CI=true yarn build passes. However the removal is incomplete: backend still accepts card orders as paid and still accepts/stores seller applications with payout_method='stripe_connect'; /payment/success also still polls a missing payment-status endpoint and logs 404s.

critical.issue: After Stripe removal, payment_method='card' still returns 200 and creates a paid order. This leaves a hidden card/Stripe-era payment path and can mark orders paid without a card processor.
Backend still accepts and persists payout_method='stripe_connect' (runtime negative test returned 200). SellerApplication/SellerApplicationCreate also still default/allow stripe_connect.

minor.issue: Old Stripe-related tests/comments and store_boosts session/webhook helper references remain; backend .env contains real-looking third-party credentials/secrets that should not be deploy artifacts and should be rotated if real. Legacy user stripe_* fields were noted as intentional compatibility.
Current backend is running and compileall passes, but logs still contain an earlier transient NameError for stripe_payments_router before the final restart/fix.

integration_issues.issue: PaymentSuccess copy is now generic, but the page still polls /api/payments/status/{session_id}; that backend endpoint is absent and browser console records repeated 404s. This appears to be a dangling Stripe/card checkout success flow.

action_items: Reject/remove payment_method='card' in backend order creation and update API comments/types so only wallet, crypto, and bank remain.
Change seller application backend model/default/validation to bank_transfer only (or explicitly reject new stripe_connect submissions while tolerating legacy stored documents).
Remove or repurpose the old PaymentSuccess/PaymentCancel card-session route so it no longer calls missing /api/payments/status and produces 404s.
Clean remaining Stripe-era comments/tests/helpers and remove/rotate real-looking secrets from deploy artifacts before marking deployment-ready.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py lines around OrderCreate/create_order still document and allow 'card' as a payment method.
server.py SellerApplication/SellerApplicationCreate still include Literal['stripe_connect','bank_transfer'] with default 'stripe_connect'.
PaymentSuccess.jsx still calls api.get(`/payments/status/${sessionId}`), but no backend route exists after Stripe removal.
Checkout.jsx UI hides card successfully, but unused CreditCard/card state remains and should be cleaned to avoid future reactivation.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary QA listings for wallet/card checkout checks and one temporary verified user e2e_stripe_removed_*@example.com for seller-apply negative validation. No MOCKED Stripe APIs were used; Twilio OTP and shipping remain MOCKED app services.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest only the Stripe-removal/deployment readiness flow. Previously passing: /api root/sitemap/robots/wallet-ticker 200, /api/stripe/connect/status and /onboard 404, /store-boost/checkout 503 friendly disabled message, wallet checkout 200 paid order, frontend CI build, Checkout/Verification/SellerApply visible UI checks. Recheck the two failed backend negatives and PaymentSuccess 404 after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: The fix removed the Stripe router and visible frontend card/Connect UI, but did not fully update backend domain validation/defaults and did not retire the old card payment success route. As a result, hidden API paths still preserve Stripe/card semantics even though the user-facing tiles were removed.
